title: Request inspector in MCP clients
items: get_request, get_email, wait_for_request and wait_for_email open an interactive inspector in clients with MCP Apps (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor): the request line and the answer it got, headers with secrets masked, the body as folding JSON, and for an email its code, links, checks, text and attachments
The inspector lists the endpoint's recent requests to click through, follows the client's light or dark theme, and reaches nothing on the network itself
Clients without MCP Apps see the same answers as before; both tools also return them as structuredContent
